apiRequestPathPolicy: pathname only; request/response bodies omitted; byte lengths recorded for health, employees, clocking options and users; clocking options also records row count; /api/employees records only whether status=Activo; optional active-filter and field-projection diagnostics use PERFORMANCE_ACTIVE_EMPLOYEE_FILTER_PROBE=1 and PERFORMANCE_EMPLOYEE_CLOCKING_PROJECTION_PROBE=1; readiness query correlation is checked in memory and its value is omitted; /api/shift-reports records only closed-handover presence; /api/records captures pageSize and filter-presence booleans only
syncPhasePolicy: opt-in CustomEvent records phase, name, monotonic start, duration and outcome only; user/session data omitted
readinessProbePolicy: an optional unique query marker identifies the browser request; Fastify logs are correlated by the browser request interval within 500 ms; query contents and response bodies are never written to evidence
readinessMetric: Sync step and API request timeline, initial sync overlay LCP candidate and hit-test under a clean authenticated context
readinessMainThreadAttributionPolicy: opt-in Long Animation Frame entries retain only pathname, bounded function/invoker type, script timing and frame blocking duration; origin, query, fragment and payload are omitted
